message: The other night, I decided to test our smoke alarms while making dinner. The alarms went off, and instead of panicking, I turned it into a mini family event. We gathered in the living room, practiced our escape plan, and even made a game out of it! It felt good to take a moment to check in on safety while sharing a few laughs. Sometimes, turning a potential stressor into a cozy family moment can make all the difference. How do you keep fire safety light and engaging at home?
